title: Initial temperature regulation of precursor solution assembly enables high performance organic solar cells
content:
Sustainable Energy Fuels, 2026, Advance Article
DOI: 10.1039/D6SE00495D, Paper
Xinyu Pu, Qifa Zheng, Zhenye Li, Hanjian Lai
Precursor-solution temperature regulates PM6:L8-BO pre-aggregation, optimizing thin-film microstructure and achieving 20.23% PCE, with the strategy also effective for D18:L8-BO and PM6:Y6 at 60 °C (20.59% and 17.94% PCE).
